A09.question: Can I change a student's attendance record to excused in Blackboard?
A09.note: attendance guide p2 tip, verbatim: an absent student with an acceptable excuse may be marked excused (whether an excuse is acceptable stays handbook policy)
A09.answer: If a student was absent with an acceptable excuse, you may change their attendance record to excused.

B05.question: What is the default attendee role for students in Blackboard Collaborate?
B05.note: Collaborate guide p2: the default attendee role for students is participants
B05.answer: The default attendee role for students is participants.

B10.question: How do I export the attendance sheet for my Blackboard Collaborate sessions?
B10.note: Collaborate guide p4 'D- Checking Session Attendance', all three bullets in order: open the attendance tool from Details & Actions, select overview, export icon downloads an Excel sheet
B10.answer:
D- Checking Session Attendance:

- From the Details & Actions panel, Click on attendance tool.

- On the attendance panel, select overview at the top right.

- You will have an overview for all sessions conducted, the students will be marked automatically, and the instructor will be able to change the marks as absent, excused, late and present. If you want to export the attendance sheet, click on export icon, and an excel sheet will be downloaded to your device.

M01.question: How do I create a discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
M01.note: communication guide p1: the two places to create a discussion and the plus sign/settings; the New Discussion page fields (p2: title, guidelines, show/hide) are not included
M01.answer:
You can create discussions in two locations within your course:

1. Create a discussion directly on the Course Content page, so students can view it in context with other materials.

2. Select the Discussions tab on the navigation bar to open the course discussions page. Select the plus sign in the upper-right corner to open the menu. You can add discussions and organize them with folders. Select the gear icon to open the Discussion Settings panel. You can allow students to create discussions that appear in the list with the label Created by student. You can turn this setting on and off at any time.

M06.question: Can students edit their discussion titles in Blackboard Ultra?
M06.note: communication guide p3: students cannot edit their discussion titles after they create discussions
M06.answer: Students cannot edit their discussion titles after they create discussions.

M08.question: How do I enable class conversations on a Blackboard content item?
M08.note: communication guide p4 'Conversations': enable (item Settings icon > Allow class conversations) and access
M08.answer:
Conversations:

- Enable conversations: Select the item's Settings icon to open the panel with the item's details and information. Select Allow class conversations.

- Access conversations: When someone contributes to a conversation, an icon appears next to the item's title on the Course Content page. Open the item's menu and select Conversation to open the conversation in a new layer, or select the Open class conversation icon in the upper-right corner of an item's page or submissions page. A purple circle appears with the icon to indicate new activity.

X03.question: How do I send an announcement in Blackboard, and how do I create a discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
X03.note: two clauses, each verified on its own: the complete short-guide announcement section (p9, correct) and the two discussion locations (p1, limited as in M01); no bridge text
X03.answer:
Send an Announcement:

- From details and actions click on create Announcements.

- Click on the Plus sign in the top right of the page.

- Add the Title, recipients and message of the announcement.

- If you want to send a copy of this announcement via Email, check “Send an email copy to recipients” option.

- If you want to schedule the announce and control the visibility, check “schedule announcement” option and choose the start and end dates and time.

- Click on save – a draft of the announcement will be saved.

- Click on Post so the announcement will reach students.

- You can edit copy or delete announcement by going to the announcement page, then click on the “Three dots” icon, then you will find Edit, Copy and delete.

You can create discussions in two locations within your course:

1. Create a discussion directly on the Course Content page, so students can view it in context with other materials.

2. Select the Discussions tab on the navigation bar to open the course discussions page. Select the plus sign in the upper-right corner to open the menu. You can add discussions and organize them with folders. Select the gear icon to open the Discussion Settings panel. You can allow students to create discussions that appear in the list with the label Created by student. You can turn this setting on and off at any time.
